comment: THE PLUTUS-BROWSER VERB TABLE. The CLI cli/plutus-browser is the only implementation; the OMP extension reads this table to turn a tool call into CLI argv and adds nothing. A new verb is one row here plus its case in the CLI.

id.description: a core computer instance id 10..99 (0..9 are pinebox's); the control port is 30000 + id. OPTIONAL for `up`: omit it and the core allocates this session's instance. Another session's id is refused by name.

url.description: an http(s) URL: navigate's target, or the page `up` opens once the browser answers

js.description: eval: ONE JavaScript expression run in the page, <= 20000 chars; its value is returned

match.description: text: an extended regex; only the visible-text lines matching it are returned (e.g. '\d\.\d{3,4}|mn\)|bn\)' for the expiry levels)

out.description: shot: a file path for the PNG (default: the runtime dir; only a frame under the runtime dir is attached as an image)

x.description: input click: x in page CSS pixels

y.description: input click: y in page CSS pixels

key.description: input key: a key name, e.g. Enter, Tab, PageDown

text.description: input text: the text to insert at the focused element

adapter.description: up: force a computer-use display adapter (weston-x11 | weston-vnc | xvfb | existing)

size.description: up: the display size WxH, e.g. 1626x931
